title: प्रकाश : जो अल्पायूमै निभे
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेपाली कम्युनिष्ट पार्टीका संयोजक पुष्पकमल दाहाल ‘प्रचण्ड’ पुत्रवियोगमा परेको ९ वर्ष पुगेको छ । २०७३ साल मंसिर ३ गते प्रचण्डपुत्र प्रकाश दाहालको निधन भएको थियो । प्रकाश प्रचण्डका एक मात्र छोरा थिए । पिताको पदचिन्हमा हिँडेर जनयुद्धसमेत लडेका प्रकाश शान्तिप्रक्रियामा आएपछि भने विभिन्न विवादमा मुछिए । प्रचण्ड प्रधानमन्त्री छँदा प्रकाशले उनको सचिवालयमा रहेर बुवालाई सहयोग गरेका थिए । यसक्रममा उनले सत्ता र शक्तिको दुरुपयोग गरेको आरोपहरू खेप्नु परेको थियो । दुई विवाह गरेका प्रकाशको ३६ वर्षको अल्पायूमै निधन भयो । २०७४ मंसिर ३ गते बिहान काठमाडौंको लाजिम्पाटस्थित निवासमा उनी अचेत अवस्थामा भेटिएका थिए । त्यस दिन प्रचण्ड चुनावी अभियानका क्रममा झापामा थिए । प्रकाश केही दिनदेखि अस्वस्थ रहेको र चितवनबाट काठमाडौं फर्किएको त्यसबेला प्रकाशित समाचारहरुमा उल्लेख छ । परिवारका सदस्यले उनलाई बिहान नर्भिक अस्पताल पुर्‍याएका थिए । अस्पतालका चिकित्सकले बिहान करिब ५:५० बजे अस्पताल ल्याउँदा नै उनको मृत्यु भइसकेको बताएका थिए । नर्भिक अस्पतालले आकस्मिक हृदयाघातका कारण निधन भएको पुष्टि गरेको थियो । उनको शव परीक्षण गरिएको थिएन । त्यतिबेला प्रचण्ड चुनावी अभियान छाडेर झापाबाट काठमाडौं फर्किएका थिए । पशुपति आर्यघाटमा प्रचण्डले नै दागबत्ती दिएका थिए । प्रकाशले सर्वोच्च शिखर सगरमाथा आरोहणसमेत गरेका छन् । २०६९ जेठ १३ गते उनले कृष्ण केसीको नेतृत्वमा गएको टोलीसँगै सगरमाथाको सफल आरोहण गरेका थिए । उक्त टोलीमा बिना मगर, सरल सहयात्री, युवराज दुलाललगायतका युवा नेताहरू पनि थिए । सगरमाथा आरोहणमा साथ दिएकी बिना मगरसँग उनको दोस्रो विवाह भएको हो । टोलीले सगरमाथाको चुचुरोमा नेपालको राष्ट्रिय झण्डासँगै कम्युनिस्ट पार्टीको झण्डासमेत फहराएको थियो । नेपाल पर्वतारोहण संघले नुवाकोटको ककनीमा सालिकसमेत निर्माण गरेको छ । २०७९ असार १७ गते प्रचण्डले उक्त सालिक अनावरण गरेका थिए । बहुपत्नी विवाद र कारबाही प्रकाशले जीवनमा तीन विवाह गरेका थिए । पहिलो विवाह तत्कालीन माओवादी नेता पोष्टबहादुर बोगटीकी कान्छी छोरी प्रभा बोगटीसँग २०६२ सालमा भएको हो । प्रभासित २०६४ सालमा सम्बन्धविच्छेद गरेका उनले सोही साल कास्कीको हेम्जाकी सिर्जना त्रिपाठीसित विवाह गरे । सिर्जनाबाट प्रकाशका एक छोरा प्रसिद्ध दाहाल छन् । प्रकाशले तेस्रो विवाह पार्टीकै सहयोद्धा बिना मगरसँग गरे । सगरमाथा आरोहणका बेला उनीहरुबीचको सम्बन्ध सार्वजनिक चर्चामा आएको थियो । बिना त्यसबेला सरस्वती क्याम्पसकी स्ववियु सभापति र अखिल क्रान्तिकारीकी केन्द्रीय सदस्य थिइन् । सिर्जनासित सम्बन्धविच्छेद नगरी प्रकाशले बिनालाई पत्नी बनाएका हुन् । बिना पनि विवाहित नै थिइन् । माओवादीले सांस्कृतिक विचलनको आरोपमा प्रकाश र बिना दुवैलाई कारवाहीसमेत गरेको थियो । प्रकाश र बिनाबाट पनि एक छोरा प्रवल दाहाल छन् । जेठा छोरा प्रसिद्ध र कान्छा प्रवलबीच चार वर्षजतिको अन्तर छ । प्रकाशको निधन हुँदा बिना कञ्चनपुर क्षेत्र नम्बर १ बाट प्रतिनिधिसभा सदस्यको उम्मेदवार थिइन् । उनी चुनावी अभियानमै थिइन् । प्रकाशको निधन पश्चात जेठी पत्नी सिर्जना बेहोश भएकी थिइन् । उनलाई अस्पताल भर्ना गर्नु परेको थियो । उनले एकल आमाका रुपमा छोरालाई हुर्काएकी हुन् । २०७९ मा उनी पोखरा महानगरपालिकाको उपप्रमुखको उम्मेदवारका रूपमा माओवादी केन्द्रबाट सिफारिस भएकी थिइन् । त्यतिबेला उनी पोखरामै बसेर पार्टी राजनीतिमा सक्रिय थिइन् । दुवै पत्नीले सम्झिए प्रकाशको नवौं स्मृति दिवसमा दुवै पत्नीहरुले उनलाई सम्झिएका छन् । सिर्जनाले फेसबुकमा प्रकाशको तस्विर हाल्दै मार्मिक स्टाटस लेखेकी छन् । उनी लेख्छिन्, ‘छोराको अनुहार, स्वभाव र हरेक कुरामा तिम्रो छविको अनुभूति हुन्छ प्रकाश । तिमी सँधै हामीमाझ छौ । हार्दिक श्रद्धा सुमन । अजम्बरी प्रेम र सम्झना ।’ बिना मगरले पनि स्वर्गीय पतिलाई सम्झिँदै फेसबुकमा स्टाटस लेखेकी छन् । उनी लेख्छिन्, ‘आज तिम्रो स्मृति । दिन, महिना अनि वर्षहरु जति बित्दै गए पनि पिडाका घाउहरु झनै बल्झिँदो रहेछ प्रकाश ।’ Kathmandu. It has been 9 years since the death of Nepali Communist Party Coordinator Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda'. Prachanda's son Prakash Dahal passed away on Mangsir 3, 2073 BS. Prakash was Prachanda's only son. Prakash, who followed in his father's footsteps and even fought in the People's War, became embroiled in various controversies after joining the peace process. Prakash had supported his father in his secretariat when Prachanda was Prime Minister. During this time, he had to face accusations of abuse of power and authority. Prakash, who had been married twice, passed away at the young age of 36. He was found unconscious at his residence in Lazimpat, Kathmandu on the morning of November 20, 2017. On that day, Prachanda was in Jhapa during his election campaign. According to news published at the time, Prakash had been unwell for a few days and had returned to Kathmandu from Chitwan. Family members took him to Norvic Hospital in the morning. Doctors at the hospital declared him dead at around 5:50 am. Norvic Hospital confirmed that he died of a sudden heart attack. An autopsy was not performed on his body. At that time, Prachanda had left the election campaign and returned to Kathmandu from Jhapa. Prachanda himself had lit the lamp at Pashupati Aryaghat. Prakash has also climbed the highest peak, Mount Everest. On 13 Jestha 2069, he successfully climbed Mount Everest with a team led by Krishna KC. The team also included young leaders including Bina Magar, Saral Saha Yatri, Yubaraj Dulal. This is his second marriage to Bina Magar, who had supported him in climbing Mount Everest. The team hoisted the national flag of Nepal as well as the flag of the Communist Party on the peak of Mount Everest. The Nepal Mountaineering Association has also built a statue in Kakani, Nuwakot. Prachanda unveiled the statue on Asad 17, 2079. Polygamy Disputes and Actions Prakash had married three times in his life. His first marriage was to Prabha Bogati, the younger daughter of the then Maoist leader Posta Bahadur Bogati, in 2062 BS. He divorced Prabha in 2064 BS and married Sirjana Tripathi of Hemja, Kaski in the same year. Prakash has a son, Prasidh Dahal, from Sirjana. Prakash married his third wife, Bina Magar, a fellow party member. Their relationship came into public discussion during the Everest expedition. At that time, Bina was the president of Saraswati Campus's Independent Student Union and a central member of Akhil Krantikari. Prakash made Bina his wife without divorcing Srijana. Bina was also married. The Maoists had even taken action against both Prakash and Bina on charges of cultural deviation. Prakash and Bina also have a son, Prabal Dahal. There is a four-year age gap between the eldest son, Prasidh, and the youngest, Prabal. When Prakash passed away, Bina was a candidate for the House of Representatives from Kanchanpur Constituency No. 1. She was in the midst of an election campaign. After Prakash's death, his eldest wife, Sirjana, fainted. She had to be admitted to the hospital. She raised her son as a single mother. In 2079, she was recommended by the Maoist Center as a candidate for the deputy mayor of Pokhara Metropolitan City. At that time, she was active in party politics, living in Pokhara. Both wives remembered On Prakash's ninth anniversary, both wives remembered him. Sirjana posted a picture of Prakash on Facebook and wrote a poignant status. She writes, 'Prakash, your image is felt in my son's face, nature and everything. You are always with us. Heartfelt condolences Suman. Unwavering love and memories.' Bina Magar has also written a status on Facebook remembering her late husband. She writes, 'Today is your memory. As the days, months, and years pass, the wounds of pain only grow brighter, Prakash.'
